definitionZh: CSS 属性位置设定一个元素在文档中的位置 。 上,右,下,和左物理属性以及内置-块启动,内置-块端启动,内置-内置-端启动,内置-内置-端流相对逻辑属性可以用来确定定位元素的最终位置.
sourceDefinition: The position CSS property sets how an element is positioned in a document. The top, right, bottom, and left physical properties and the inset-block-start, inset-block-end, inset-inline-start, and inset-inline-end flow-relative logical properties can be used to determine the final location of positioned elements.
